mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspace_ai_settings ( workspace_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, base_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'https://api.deepseek.com', model_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek-flash', api_key TEXT, custom_prompt TEXT, updated_by VARCHAR(32), updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id AS workspaceId, enabled, base_url AS baseUrl, model_name AS modelName, api_key AS apiKey, custom_prompt AS customPrompt, updated_by AS updatedBy, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM workspace_ai_settings WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_ai_settings (workspace_id, enabled, base_url, model_name, api_key, custom_prompt, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, CAST(#{enabled} AS BOOLEAN), #{baseUrl}, #{modelName}, #{apiKey}, #{customPrompt}, #{updatedBy}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, base_url = EXCLUDED.base_url, model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, api_key = EXCLUDED.api_key, custom_prompt = EXCLUDED.custom_prompt, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = NOW()
